name: Woodlawn Regional Park - Boundary Dam
note: Woodlawn Regional Park's second campground, on a point in Boundary Dam Reservoir 8 km south and 2 km west of Estevan, beside the park's beach and boat launch. Mostly seasonal: about 45 of its 144 RV sites are short-term sites, 31 of them sold online by the night. No grad parties on the May long weekend. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: woodlawnregionalpark.com/woodlawn-boundary/ (non-profit regional park under The Regional Parks Act; 'All sites are full service. Sewer Water 30 amp power'; RV or Trailer C$50 a day, seasonal May 1 - Sept. 30 by wait list) + its 2026 campground map (144 RV sites, 45 marked Short Term, 8 pull-through 800-807, 9 tenting) + Let's Camp public JSON for woodlawn-boundary-dam (status live, online bookings on, minNights 1; 31 RV sites 30 A full service, maxRvLength 40 ft, sold online by the night) + Google 'Woodlawn Regional Park - Boundary Dam' 4.1 (82), 306-637-3837; read 2026-11-19 -> real public RV campground, ~31% nightly (passes 1-in-10), no lots sold, no standing minimum. Local: no price gate. Not in DB (nearest entry 9287 Woodlawn Regional Park, same operator, 5.4 km NE). (phase-7 SK lead 3, found p3-524) --Claude
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery viewed 2026-11-19 at 49.0738,-103.0295 (1.2 km frame) and close frames at 49.0767,-103.0280 and 49.0737,-103.0272, against the operator's 2026 campground map and Let's Camp site photos: the nightly shore row 113-122 sits on the inland side of the boat-launch road, ~60-120 m from the reservoir's high-water edge with the road, a day-use lawn (gazebo) and a wooded shore belt between, and its site photos show trees, no water; the south row 701-707 is ~70-80 m from the south arm's high-water edge across the park's gravel access road and a grass strip, on a bench ~10 m above the water (Open-Meteo DEM ~570 m at the pads vs ~560 m on the water), and its photos looking that way show the road and far-shore fields with no water visible; 101-102 sit behind the day-use beach, concession and stage under trees; the 123-128 and 521-523 sites nearer the shore are tent-only. No nightly RV site within ~50 m over open ground and no photo showing the lake -> not waterfront (default down). Not below the dam: water at ~560 m on both sides of the point. --Claude

fees.note: Full-service RV or trailer site C$50 a night, C$250 a week, C$900 for 28 nights, C$2,650 for the season (May 1 - Sept. 30, two seasonal park passes and tax included); tent sites C$25. Park entry C$10 a day or C$60 for the season. Read 2026-11-19.

fees_source: https://woodlawnregionalpark.com/woodlawn-boundary/ ('RV or Trailer Day $50.00 Weekly (7 nights) $250.00 Monthly (28 nights) $900.00 Seasonal (May 1 – Sept. 30)* $2,650 Tenting Night $25.00 Park Entry Day $10.00 Seasonal $60.00'), read 2026-11-19

booking.note: Bookings for long weekends and for July and August are non-refundable; at other times a cancellation 48 hours ahead is refunded less C$15.

Mostly seasonal (~31% short-term by the operator map; 31 of 144 RV sites bookable online); kept per the 10-50% rule with the note line. Google 4.1 (82) is the park's Boundary Dam listing (beach and boat launch share it).
Let's Camp's own pin (49.07382,-103.02947) sits at the beach-road junction ~150 m SW of the loops; pinned on the loops instead.
max_rig_ft 40 is the same maxRvLength on every online RV site (possibly an engine default), but site 800 also carries a deliberate 20-ft minimum, so the values were set by hand.
